Lightweight LLMs optimized for mobile devices are suggested for resource-constrained settings.
cultural_adaptation: Cultural adaptation challenges were identified including cultural misalignments where LLM recommendations felt like stereotypical American responses, linguistic biases compelling users to use English, and therapeutic misalignment. The review recommends developing culturally adapted LLM interfaces and customizing to different cultural settings. No formal adaptation framework is named; recommendations are for future work rather than reporting completed adaptations.
implementation_contexts: Studies were conducted across diverse health care settings including home care settings (10/29, 35%) and clinical settings (9/29, 31%) being the most common, along with community-based settings, outpatient settings, low-resource primary care settings, and online platforms.
